note: v1 90.384 on seed 0, 90.365 on seed 11: Low Pressure, dub-wise space (260 s, 70 bpm, A minor). An original one-drop riddim mixed live: intro (the rhodes skank alone in the spring, then the one-drop) / riddim (sub bass RIDDIM, skank on 2 and 4, a wurli bubble) / melodica (THE CALL on boc-lead, each phrase thrown into a feedback tape echo) / version (16 bars of dub mixing: the desk decides who plays, bar by bar; the bass drops the one; the B part Fmaj7 | E7sus under the drop-outs) / breakdown (bass and drums, then the skank alone) / return / outro (falling away into the echo). Slow granular wow on the keys and lead, vinyl hiss and crackle, tape saturation on the master. From the first draft 80.66: echo on a dotted eighth (3/16), the hats as a 3+3+2 steppers cell dragged by an eighth swing (0.64; swing16 alone never moved hats on the 8ths) - rhythm 56 -> 71; the master eq off the mids (640 Hz -9 dB, 300 Hz -3 dB) and the top opened (+4 dB above 6k) - spectrum 57 -> 96; the crackle sparser and quieter so the sections' densities differ - variety 79 -> 95.
next: rhythm 71 (off-grid share 0.05: more dotted figures, a double skank?); structure 91 (section lengths uneven: the 4-bar intro vs 16-bar sections); a dub siren; Harry's ear.
